lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb4In2Au2 (reduced formula Rb2InAu) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 119), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives Au and In centers eight Rb neighbors each, while Rb centers have ten geometric neighbors (four Au, two In, four Rb). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between Au and In 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Rb 10-vertex polyhedra.
